notes.subject: tulo bila
notes.rationale: האזינה literally 'broaden the ear' — Bamanankan kɔgɔdaɲɛ 'tulo bila' ye a cogo tilennen ye

notes.subject: האזינה/הקשיבה
notes.rationale: Saba daɲɛ fila-ni-fila minnu bɛ fɔ kuma kelen na: 'broaden the ear' ni 'prick up the ears' — dantigɛli bɛ don Bamanankan na

notes.subject: to Yawe
notes.rationale: Lasebali-daɲɛw (imperatives) minnu bɛ Yawe wele ka mɛn

notes.subject: to Yawe
notes.rationale: Psalmw ka kuma Yawe ye directly

translation: Tulo bila, Yawe, n ka jalaki ma, k'a finin mɛn n ka bisiguw kan.
